_comment: crossing-guard default rules (shipped, embedded via go:embed). ONE format, ONE evaluator (ADR 0025): engine.Rule with a Predicate tree, decided by engine.Decide — the same evaluator the daemon and detector-tag policy use. Used when no ~/.crossing-guard/policy/rules.json exists, so a fresh install is SANE rather than denying every tool call. A present user file fully replaces this default. Five guards match raw shell command text through the eval-only `command` tag; three stateful observe rules report high-signal session combinations in Audit without blocking. Honest limit: command regex and detector coverage are best-effort; a hard guarantee needs a non-bypassable backstop (declared per rule).
